findings.reproduction: Open the authenticated Console at a 1024 by 768 desktop viewport.
findings.expected: The fixed navigation and 640-pixel Console content remain inside the viewport without horizontal scrolling or clipped controls.
findings.actual: The shell extends 150 pixels past the viewport and clips page actions and controls.
findings.evidence: Playwright measured document overflow and clipped controls in credential-free screenshots for both roles.

findings.reproduction: Sign in as Admin and open Team.
findings.expected: The v1 Team overview offers approved basic user administration only.
findings.actual: The overview advertises deferred CSV import and arbitrary group creation.
findings.evidence: Credential-free Admin Team screenshot and accessible-role inspection.

findings.reproduction: Start the keep-running F0-UAT0 environment from clean temporary state and open Overview.
findings.expected: A clean founder environment reports the actual healthy baseline unless a supported alert is active.
findings.actual: The UAT fixture posts an alert outside the Product allowlist, so the Product correctly omits it and reports Degraded and Needs attention.
findings.evidence: Overview and Hardware screenshots plus source trace from the UAT alert fixture to the strict Alertmanager allowlist.

findings.reproduction: Inspect visible interactive bounds in the authenticated Console.
findings.expected: Frequently used targets should be comfortably operable at desktop sizes.
findings.actual: Several targets are 20 to 32 pixels high. Focus-visible styling, form labels, accessible names, heading structure, and keyboard shortcuts are present.
findings.evidence: Playwright geometry and source-level focus-style inspection.
